en: Read last-known conversation history when the current session association needs confirmation, with a clear read-only state.
Show recorded file reads and searches consistently in Activity and Trace, while keeping the original tool details available.
zh: 会话关联待确认时，可只读查看已记录的对话历史，明确说明当前状态。
Activity 和 Trace 统一显示实际记录的文件读取、搜索等动作，保留原始工具详情。

en: Load recent Chat turns first in long sessions, with earlier history available on demand and a stable reading position.
Keep HQ replies in their source inbox instead of delivering a delayed stream of full coordination messages.
Show clearer text and image delivery receipts, with stable retries for the intended conversation.
Correct stale working states and elapsed times while preserving genuine work and approval prompts.
zh: 长会话优先加载最近对话，按需查看更早历史，并保留阅读位置。
HQ 回信保留在来源收件箱，不再延迟集中发送整段协调信息。
文字与图片投递回执更清晰，向指定会话稳定重试。
修正残留标记导致的进行中状态与错误计时，保留真实执行及审批提示。

en: HQ replies show their HQ identity, with more reliable matter and session status.
Chat and Trace display recorded tool inputs and results, with previews suited to each tool.
Read embedded Shell, Python and JavaScript in command calls while keeping the complete original call available.
Reduce repeated background collection while preserving current state and approval checks.
zh: HQ 回信明确显示 HQ 身份，优化事项与会话状态判断。
对话与 Trace 展示实际记录的工具输入和结果，按工具类型提供适合的预览。
命令调用中的 Shell、Python 和 JavaScript 支持代码阅读，同时保留完整调用原文。
减少重复后台采集，保留实时状态及审批检查。

en: Usage keeps slow reads alive and retains the last good figures after a failure, with clearer retry and access-error messages.
Browser and app Trace views now agree on loaded history, turn summaries, call details and original numbering.
zh: Usage 支持较慢的读取，失败时保留上次有效数据，并明确显示重试、超时及访问错误。
浏览器与 App 的 Trace 统一已加载历史、轮次摘要和调用详情，保留原始编号。

en: Chat and Trace include recorded file, command and MCP calls from current Codex, OpenCode and Kimi sessions.
Inspect file changes and complete selected edit inputs with the shared code reader.
HQ summary cards show repeated titles once and keep the reason for your decision visible.
zh: 对话与轨迹补齐新版 Codex、OpenCode 和 Kimi 实际记录的文件、命令及 MCP 调用。
文件修改和完整编辑参数共用代码阅读器，保留删除等操作的细节。
HQ 摘要卡片去掉重复标题，保留需要你处理的原因。

en: HQ shows visible and total matters, with a clear control to expand the remaining cards.
Diff actions use the same file icon with addition and removal marks throughout the app.
zh: HQ 显示当前与全部事项数量，并提供醒目的剩余卡片展开入口。
统一 App 各处 Diff 图标，使用带加减标记的文件图形。

en: Read commands in Chat and Trace with clearer source-language previews while keeping the complete original call available.
Fixed links wrapped in bold or other text styles displaying as raw Markdown.
zh: 优化对话和 Trace 中的命令阅读，按语言展示代码，同时保留完整调用原文。
修复粗体等文字样式中的链接显示为 Markdown 原文的问题。

en: Manage your existing agent sessions on Android phones and tablets with Chat, Terminal and HQ.
Read Trace, complete tool inputs and Diff using the same code readers as the other mobile clients.
Open authorized local files and embedded images, share documents and export an HQ copy.
Optional Android notifications show their setup status; the home widget shows dated, last-seen usage.
zh: 在 Android 手机和平板上管理现有 Agent 会话，使用对话、终端和 HQ。
Trace、完整工具输入和 Diff 共用移动端代码阅读体验。
预览已授权的本地文件及嵌入图片，分享文件并导出 HQ 副本。
可选 Android 通知会说明配置状态；桌面组件显示带时间的上次用量快照。
